_doc: Every visual/audio asset the MATCHER and COSMIC SPUD games wear, where it came from, its license, and how to re-fetch or re-derive it. Re-derive: python3 tools/v033p3_art.py + python3 tools/v033p3_sfx.py (patch 3 re-derives the p1/p2 set too). All sources CC0 or the owner's own upload. COSMIC SPUD (v0.3.4) re-derive: python3 tools/v034_cs_art.py + python3 tools/v034_cs_audio.py (the raw hunt cache lives outside the repo; the manifest lines below carry the sources).

audit.note: Audio kept deliberately small for v0.0.1; per-game music is a roadmap item (Docs/ideas)

assets/games/lanes/laser_thunder.png.origin: desaturate+lift recolor of PNG/Lasers/laserBlue04.png (blue -> thunder white)

assets/games/cosmic_spud.provenance: v0.3.4-1 THE ART REBIRTH: every sprite regenerated by tools/v034p1_art.py (the repo's own generator, CC0 - our own pixels). The shading engine: silhouette -> gradient base -> light/shadow bands -> dark outline -> rim light; 4x supersampled.
assets/games/cosmic_spud.notes: spudnik.png deleted (the 6 hero_<start>_f<k>.png walk sets replaced it). The cosmic coin (pickups/coin.png) is a NEW design: a gold coin with a potato embossed in the middle - deliberately NOT the box's gogacoin (assets/ui/coin.png).
